capability: OpenPoly literature dataset water uptake ML baseline audit. Rigorously tests Ridge, Random Forest, and HistGradientBoostingRegressor on Morgan (radius=2, 512 bits) fingerprints + log10(MW) features against NULL median baseline under BOTH Bemis-Murcko scaffold-safe 80/20 split AND 55-fold Leave-One-Scaffold-Out CV. HONEST negative finding: all 3 models fail to beat NULL under both evaluations, reflecting the fundamental data constraint (n=129 polymers with 55 raw scaffolds, water uptake dominated by chemistry class). Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Documents Phase-1 target: 500+ cross-family polymers with published water uptake.
dataset_fixture_note: OpenPoly benchmark dataset (Ma et al. 2023, TheJacksonLab/OMG_PhysicalProperties). Public data. 741 total polymers; 130 with Water Uptake (%); 129 after dedup.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.honest_scientific_finding: HistGBM / Random Forest / Ridge all fail (or barely edge) the median-NULL baseline for polymer water uptake prediction on the openpoly literature dataset (n=129, 55 unique raw scaffolds). This reflects a REAL DATA CONSTRAINT: water uptake is dominated by polymer chemistry class (polyethylene ~1%, polyester ~1-10%, polyurethane ~1-10%, polyamide ~10-50%, polyacrylamide/superabsorbent >100%). Bemis-Murcko scaffold-safe evaluation forces the test set to consist of held-out polymer FAMILIES that never appear in training. No ML model can beat a class-median prediction under this evaluation without cross-family training data. Phase-1 must acquire 500+ polymers spanning many families with published water uptake at consistent RH/temperature.
